# Dr. Jan Duffy — Las Vegas Real Estate Expert

> Dr. Jan Duffy is a Nevada-licensed real estate agent (License #S.0197614.LLC, PhD) with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties. Las Vegas specialist for homes that did not sell — 35+ years experience, $127M+ career sales, 500+ families served. Proven results on failed listings: 7 homes that did not sell with previous agents — now sold; 19-day average to contract; 98.7% of asking price. Serves Summerlin West luxury (The Ridges, Red Rock Country Club, The Summit), Henderson, Southern Highlands, and greater Las Vegas. Contact: (702) 500-1064.
